name: Hayle Estuary Monitoring System
description: First delivery workspace for Hayle Estuary survey imagery, section profiles, and baseline monitoring context from the Friday 17 July 2026 survey.
selectorSummary: Single-survey Hayle setup with three monitoring areas and sections enabled where exports are available.
singleScanMessage: This first Hayle delivery is built from the Friday 17 July 2026 baseline survey. Repeat-survey change views will unlock once a second comparable survey round has been added.

site.name: Hayle Estuary
site.context: This first Hayle rollout uses the FutureScaping monitoring-platform structure in a simpler baseline state, with three areas and one survey round.

programme.objectiveShort: Stand up the Hayle monitoring workspace
programme.operationalLesson: The first delivery needs to feel complete and readable even before repeat-survey change products exist.
programme.consolidationGoal: Keep the same interface pattern as the existing FutureScaping monitoring sites while trimming the first Hayle release to the assets already available.

workflow.title: Load the baseline round
workflow.copy: Use the Friday 17 July 2026 survey as the opening Hayle baseline.

workflow.title: Review imagery by area
workflow.copy: Move through the three Hayle monitoring areas using the ortho, DSM, and contour outputs already imported from processing.

workflow.title: Use sections where ready
workflow.copy: All three Hayle areas now have section profile CSVs linked into the baseline survey setup.

workflow.title: Add repeat monitoring later
workflow.copy: When the next comparable survey is added, comparison-driven change reporting can be layered in without changing the site structure.
